title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
summary: Introducing OpenAI Presence, a proven enterprise AI agent platform that helps organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows.
body: Introducing OpenAI Presence, a proven enterprise AI agent platform that helps organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出全新的企业级AI智能体平台OpenAI Presence，旨在帮助组织部署值得信赖的语音和聊天智能体，以处理客户服务和内部工作流。原始信息显示：Introducing OpenAI Presence, a proven enterprise AI agent platform that helps organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing OpenAI Presence”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出企业级AI智能体平台Presence，标志着其在对话式智能体部署上迈出重要一步。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
